modules.title: First Contact
modules.why: The doorway moment — greet elders, introduce yourself, say it's a pleasure. Lock this first.

modules.title: Politeness & Repair
modules.why: Thanks, sorry, and the phrases that rescue you when you're lost.

modules.title: Toasts
modules.why: Russian tables run on toasts. A warm toast to the family lands huge.

modules.title: Family & In-Laws
modules.why: Kinship terms — you are the зять; her parents are your тесть & тёща.

modules.title: Food & Complimenting the Cook
modules.why: Praise the тёща's cooking; accept/decline more gracefully.

modules.title: Small Talk About You
modules.why: Who you are, where you're from, how you met your wife.

modules.title: Questions They'll Ask (Listening)
modules.why: Train your EAR for the questions relatives fire back at you.

modules.title: Calendar & Weather
modules.why: Original-guide day and weather questions for easy family small talk.

modules.title: Numbers & Quantities
modules.why: Original-guide quantities: prices, months, hours worked, years, and headcounts.

modules.title: Adverbs & Descriptions
modules.why: Original-guide adverbs and adjective agreement turned into short spoken survival lines.

modules.title: Daily Routine
modules.why: Original-guide 'Мой день' phrases: eat, work, rest, homework, and evening plans.

modules.title: Hobbies & Places
modules.why: Dinner-safe small talk from the guide: music, films, home, cats, parks, stadiums, cinema, and museums.

modules.title: Appearance & People
modules.why: Original-guide person-description lane: height, eyes, hair, smile, face, and family resemblance.

modules.title: Health & Feelings
modules.why: Original-guide health check-ins: feeling unwell, headache, tiredness, sleep, hope, and болеть.

modules.title: Past Week & Events
modules.why: Original-guide past-tense small talk: last week, weekend, trips, good news, and what happened.

modules.title: Can, Want & Need
modules.why: Original-guide modal survival: can, know how, want, need, allowed, not allowed, and should.

modules.title: Work & Clients
modules.why: Short lawyer/work answers from the guide: clients, cases, court, and being busy.

modules.title: Legal Words (Recognition)
modules.why: Recognition-only legal terms from the guide so deeper work questions are less jarring.

modules.title: Holidays & Plans
modules.why: Original-guide Christmas, Thanksgiving, and family-plan small talk.

modules.title: Cultural Extras (Recognition)
modules.why: Recognition-only proverbs, idioms, and lawyer jokes from the saved guide.

modules.title: Budva Trip
